meta.feature: Bounded task execution and advisory OpenAI Decisions
meta.environment: Linux evaluator with bubblewrap; external providers default off.

goal.purpose: Reduce repeated instructions for objectively testable changes while keeping human accountability.
goal.done: Fixed criteria, bounded execution, retained evidence and safe checkpoint restart produce a revision-bound human review request.
goal.scope: Single LOW/MEDIUM task; opt-in Decisions advice; bounded retries and checkpoints.
goal.exclude: Autonomous approval/publication, HIGH/CRITICAL execution, production data, queues, multiple agents and UI.

knowledge.invariant: Self-check never constitutes human approval, merge permission or release authorization.
Required tests and acceptance inputs remain outside model write authority; an improved metric never overrides a failed required check.
Unknown in-flight work is HALTed rather than replayed. Safe checkpoints preserve attempts, evidence and remaining wall-time budget.
Decision Provider failures affect advice only; permissions, XML/schema, tests and human approval remain independent.

decision.reason: Separate proposed content from command execution, canonical source writes and human review authority.

knowledge.decision: Codex supplies bounded file-change data; the runner validates all edits before writing to its own detached worktree.
knowledge.constraint: Evaluators require functioning Linux bubblewrap. Missing isolation is a blocking environment failure.
OpenAI Decisions API and the version-pinned optional Codex broker require explicit data-transmission consent and independent quality evaluation.

case.condition: Existing failing test, incorrect proposal, corrected proposal.
case.expect: Failure evidence survives; only the passing bounded candidate advances to human review.

case.condition: Evaluator attempts source writes or host-loopback communication.
case.expect: Read-only source, hidden Git metadata and isolated network prevent the side effects.

case.condition: Mocked named OpenAI predicate/choice responses at both existing hook call sites.
case.expect: Normalized advice is compatible; required local gates remain independent.

item.next: Use a separately authorized synthetic live smoke test before opting into production decisions.

open.item: Live Decisions/Codex quality, cost and latency have not been measured; all API transport tests are mocked.

item.next: Compare accepted-delivery time, human intervention, review wait and defects against the manual workflow.

open.item: The offline repair proves mechanics and boundaries, not a whole-system benefit.
